concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑003 (pipeline execution time ≤ 6 h) is not covered by any task; there is no task that measures total runtime or asserts the 6‑hour limit, which weakens the spec requirement.
Success Criterion SC‑004 (peak memory usage < 7 GB) is absent from the task list; no task records or validates memory consumption, violating the spec’s measurable outcome.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) mandates checksums for all generated datasets, yet no task creates or records checksums for `data/raw/mobius_array.npy` or any derived files, breaching the constitution.
